reasoning_content:
Wait, I need to reconsider `SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN=`. `getInstanceConfig` checks `if (!parentDomain) return null;`. Empty string is falsy → returns null → `resolveAuthConfigForRequest` uses `getAuthConfig()` (platform) directly. Good.

But wait — `SVA_PARENT_DOMAIN` is in the compose environment list and might be required elsewhere. For local-builder, empty is fine (the guide says parent domain is for multi-host). Let me wait for the app and test /auth/me and the full dev-login flow.

action.command:
cd /workspace && for i in $(seq 1 40); do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 5 http://localhost:3000/health/live 2>/dev/null)
  [ "$code" = "200" ] && { echo "live up after ~$((i*5))s"; break; }
  sleep 5
done
echo "=== /auth/me no session (expect 401 now) ==="
curl -s -o /tmp/me.txt -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/auth/me; head -c 300 /tmp/me.txt; echo
echo "=== /api/v1/iam/me/context (expect 401/403) ==="
curl -s -o /dev/null -w 'HTTP %{http_code}\n' http://localhost:3000/api/v1/iam/me/context
echo "=== /health/ready summary ==="
curl -s --max-time 10 http://localhost:3000/health/ready | node -e "let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c).on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);console.log('status=',j.status);console.log('db=',j.checks.db,'redis=',j.checks.redis,'keycloak=',j.checks.keycloak);console.log('jobWorker=',j.checks.services?.jobWorker?.status);console.log('errors=',JSON.stringify(j.checks.errors));})"
